frames.continuity: She inclines slightly toward an off-camera partner with both open hands low and separated from the hoodie, long curls complete, and both shoes planted shoulder-width.
frames.forbidden: Idle symmetry, wave, book, foot movement, alarmed expression, cropped curls, missing drawstrings, or plaid drift.

frames.continuity: Her anatomical left palm rises to waist height to invite the partner to speak while the right arm remains relaxed and the torso opens gently.
frames.forbidden: Wave, point, raised elbow, duplicated fingers, root drift, book appearance, or exaggerated smile.
frames.pose_summary: Gentle invitation to take the conversational floor.

frames.continuity: Her head tilts slightly and shoulders soften as both hands draw inward without closing, maintaining attentive eye contact and unchanged planted shoes.
frames.forbidden: Caricature nod, crossed arms, laughter, closed fists, moving shoes, clipped hair, or book appearance.

frames.continuity: Her anatomical right hand rests lightly over the upper chest while the left remains open beside the torso and her gaze stays warm and steady.
frames.forbidden: Pledge pose, clenched fist, self-hug, hand penetrating hoodie or drawstrings, book, heel lift, or root translation.

frames.continuity: Both forearms extend slightly with open palms at different heights as she offers support with soft knees and a small encouraging expression.
frames.forbidden: Shrug, begging, wave, mirrored arms, oversized hands, foot slide, book appearance, or identity drift.

frames.continuity: Her left palm remains gently offered while the right relaxes near the hoodie pocket and her patient gaze returns agency to the partner.
frames.forbidden: Command gesture, point, book, hard pose snap, root displacement, hand inside pocket, or idle duplicate.
frames.pose_summary: Patient return of choice to the partner.

frames.continuity: Exactly one closed blue book stays tucked vertically against her anatomical right side while the free left hand makes a small open question gesture.
frames.forbidden: Wave, second book, changed book size or color, finger point, hand swap, foot movement, or cropped prop.
frames.pose_summary: Frame a question while retaining the closed source.

frames.forbidden: Floating book, swapped weight-bearing grip, unreadable hand overlap, walking stance, duplicate book, or missing pages.

frames.forbidden: Writing, multiple pointing fingers, detailed text, closed eyes, clipped curls, extra pages, book duplication, or foot slide.

frames.forbidden: Book as sign, pointing at viewer, wave, duplicated arm, unstable shoes, missing page block, or changed book ownership.
frames.pose_summary: Share the useful idea with an open-book presentation.

frames.forbidden: Dropped or disappearing book, pocket penetration, locomotion, idle-copy silhouette, hand swap, extra book, or lifted heel.
